· 全站材质升级：卡片、统计块与主按钮在发丝高光之上叠加克制的落影（新增 --sh-1/2/3 三级投影令牌），界面从「平涂」变为有厚度的釉面质感。

noteEn:
v0.29.5 Visual material polish (Xuanyao Night)

· Site-wide material upgrade: cards, stat tiles and the primary button now carry a restrained drop shadow on top of the hairline top-light (three new shadow tokens --sh-1/2/3), lifting the interface from flat fills to a glazed-porcelain depth.
· The primary button gains a brand-red glow plus a spring-eased press response (new --ease-spring token) for a more tactile tap.
· The top hairline highlight is slightly strengthened (3% to 5%) so card edges read more clearly on the dark base.
· Pure CSS polish: no functional changes, no brand-colour changes (#141a24 + #e63946), tone colours untouched. All progress and data are unaffected.
